entities.name: TGM2-like protein
observations: 687-aa query aligns to reviewed human TGM2 (UniProt P21980) at 82.8% identity and 99.9% coverage; annotation transfer is strong homology support, not direct assay of this query.
Pfam matches transglutaminase N-terminal (PF00868), core (PF01841), and C-terminal (PF00927) domains.

Likely calcium-dependent protein-glutamine gamma-glutamyltransferase: cross-links glutamine and lysine residues or conjugates primary amines; TGM2 homologs may also catalyze protein deamidation and monoamine incorporation.

Homolog reference roles include wound healing, extracellular-matrix organization, apoptosis, angiogenesis, differentiation, and chromatin modification; relevance to the query is inferred from homology.
Likely predominantly cytosolic, with reported nuclear/chromatin, membrane, mitochondrial, and secreted/extracellular-matrix locations for TGM2 homologs; localization can depend on cell context.
Calcium is a cofactor; GTP inhibits transamidase activity in the curated human homolog. Reference annotation describes monomeric protein; exact query state is not experimentally established.
